title: How to Make MV Tileset s smaller? (or rm2k3 charset bigger)

posts.author: xTHExSILENCE
posts.body:
It's hard to explain, I'll do my best.
I'm using old rm2k3 charsets in the rpg maker mv engine. Which means my characters are much smaller than the tilesets for MV. Is there a way to make the MV tile sets smaller, or perhaps, make the rm2k3 charsets bigger, without losing any quality in the sprite sheet? I have tried loading the tileset in GIMP, and reducing it by 1/3, but that makes the editor boxes not aligned with the new tileset. What would you do? What is the best solution? Sorry if this is a noobish question, I've looked for quite some time and can't seem to find a good answer.
Thank you!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
xTHExSILENCE said:
So the Shaz plugin will make it so the older tile sets will fit the MV engine? Can I switch back and forth if necessary, or does it change it all?
Click to expand...
not exactly.
nothing can change the editor itself, so you would need a placeholder tileset in 48x48 to do the mapping.
and then the tilesize plugin would redirect all map functions from the placeholder tileset and the 48x grid to use the smaller tiles with a grid setup in the plugin instead of the default grid.
and you can make multiple replacement tilesets and switch between them as long as all replacement sets fit the placeholder set used in the editor.
